answer.reason: Joshua's altar and the writing of the law on Mount Ebal are events that happened there, stated in the verses.

clauses.english: was where Joshua built an altar to the LORD God of Israel
clauses.quote: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

clauses.english: was where Joshua wrote a copy of the law of Moses upon the stones
clauses.quote: he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses

doubts: DEU 11:29, DEU 27:4 and DEU 27:13 give commands and promises about the mountain, not events, so they are not used as clauses.
